method: Isolated profiles and private filesystem view of the verified 0.2.1 package, with development module/Qt observer overlays. Browser authorization was relayed to the normal host browser because the read-only test filesystem prevents Firefox Snap startup. No system installation was changed.

english.releaseMessage:
Penguin Studio 0.2.1 is available.

The package will be verified before installation. Linux may ask for administrator approval. Restart Penguin Studio after the update.

german.releaseMessage:
Penguin Studio 0.2.1 ist verfügbar.

Das Paket wird vor der Installation geprüft. Linux kann eine Administratorbestätigung anfordern. Starte Penguin Studio nach dem Update neu.

offline_checks: Device authorization polling/backoff and rotating refresh tokens
Scope validation, disconnect cancellation and shutdown callbacks
Channel metadata loading and preservation of an in-flight user edit
Chat plain-text rendering, duplicate messages, deletion, clearing and bounded history
Release channel, version, architecture/distribution and digest selection
Real GitHub percent-encoded Ubuntu asset URL regression
Production updater rejects malformed metadata, incorrect SHA-256 and oversized downloads
Production updater refuses download/install while outputs are active
limitations: No live chat message was sent and no Twitch stream metadata was changed.
No real package-manager installation or automatic restart was performed.
Native graphical tests cover Ubuntu GNOME Wayland; Fedora, Flatpak and Snap GUI behavior is not covered by these runs.
The live OAuth check used a development module during implementation; final input-length/reset refinements were subsequently compiled and covered by offline tests.
